engine: three.js + vite. Native engine migration not started. See docs/engine.md.
fps90: NOT MEASURED on a reference PC. First hardware-GPU runs (Apple M1, headless Chrome, 60 Hz cap) are streaming-stall measurements, not a 90 FPS test. See docs/perf.md, 2026-10-30.

items.name: Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban
items.note: OSM way 18085267 kept. Visual and collision height 33.5 m peripheral, 47 m inner ring. Horizontal joints, circles, and triangles sit on the walls. They are not cut openings and not a scanned Kahn model.

items.name: Ahsan Manzil
items.note: OSM way 624025793. Pink mass and towers. Reference approximation.

items.name: Lalbagh Fort

items.name: Bangladesh National Museum
items.note: OSM way 7392256 at Shahbagh. Exterior mass only.

items.name: Curzon Hall
items.note: OSM way 1132918478, nearest large footprint. Not the whole campus and not a measured hall.

items.name: Kawran Bazar and New Market
items.note: Showroom stall clusters only. Not the market sheds.

items.name: Food, phone, book, clothing, daily, tea, flower
items.note: Shahbagh tea and flower only. G on foot orders, waits, and pays 15 or 40 taka. A keeper stays beside each table and one nearby civilian can browse. Walk-off cancels. No held prop, no skeletal clip, and the other stall types are still props.

items.name: Shahjalal terminal, interior, aircraft
items.note: One Biman-colored jet is placed, offset. No logos. No flight sim.

items.name: Gabtoli and Mohakhali
items.note: Showroom bays. Buses do not serve them.

items.name: Benapole Express, track, Kamalapur
items.note: A loco and coach sit near Kamalapur. They do not run the rail graph.

items.name: Metro train, viaduct, station
items.note: Uttara display viaduct. Not the Line 6 alignment.

items.name: Buses, police, CNG, rickshaw, cars, motorcycle
items.note: Some are placed as static props. Traffic still uses its own proxy meshes.

items.name: NPC library
items.note: Street population instances the catalog meshes and walks sidewalks. No skeletal clips.

items.name: Chunk streaming
items.note: 500 m scheduler, now nearest-first, drops stale jobs and late arrivals, generation-guarded builds. Collision indexes per chunk and batches rebuild once per chunk. Measured on an M1 route: time in >50 ms frames about halved. Mesh build, nav rebuild and JSON parse still run on the main thread; stalls up to about 1 s remain.

items.name: Road graph topology
items.note: Generator fixed and tested: road vertices shared by two or more ways are pinned through simplification. Shipped data still has 5,565 components and about 6,700 dead ends within 5 cm of another road. Needs the 356 MB Geofabrik extract (bangladesh-261028.osm.pbf) to regenerate.

items.name: 90 FPS on a high-end PC
items.note: No high-end GPU in this workspace. The last software-GPU Dhanmondi window was not 30 FPS.
